key.name: language
key.summary: Interface language ('auto' follows the system language, or a locale code such as 'en' or 'tr')

key.name: always-visible
key.summary: Keep the island visible as a compact pill even when nothing is active

key.name: idle-content
key.summary: Content shown inside the island when idle and always visible

key.name: idle-icon-path
key.summary: Path to a custom SVG or PNG icon used in minimal icon idle mode (empty uses default)

key.name: idle-expand-clock
key.summary: Show large clock and full date when the idle island is expanded

key.name: idle-expand-icon
key.summary: Show enlarged minimal or custom icon when the idle island is expanded

key.name: idle-expand-battery
key.summary: Show live battery status when the idle island is expanded (auto-hidden on desktops)

key.name: idle-expand-bluetooth
key.summary: Show live Bluetooth status when the idle island is expanded

key.name: idle-expand-volume
key.summary: Show quick volume slider when the idle island is expanded

key.name: position
key.summary: Island position on screen

key.name: margin
key.summary: Distance from the screen edge (px)

key.name: width
key.summary: Minimum island width (px), 0 sizes it to the content, below 0 tightens the resting island

key.name: art-size
key.summary: Cover art size in the resting island (px)

key.name: art-size-expanded
key.summary: Cover art size in the expanded island (px)

key.name: art-shape
key.summary: Cover art shape, auto is round when resting and rounded square when expanded

key.name: art-border
key.summary: Frame around the cover art

key.name: art-compact
key.summary: Show the cover art in the resting island

key.name: art-spin
key.summary: Spin the cover like a vinyl record while playing

key.name: text-width
key.summary: Maximum width of the title text (px), longer titles are ellipsized

key.name: expand-on
key.summary: What opens the details view

key.name: dodge-duration
key.summary: Seconds before the island silently returns to its home position after a temporary dodge

key.name: positioning-active
key.summary: Temporary placement mode triggered from Preferences to choose a permanent custom position

key.name: pin-active
key.summary: Whether a custom permanent position offset is currently saved

key.name: pin-offset-x
key.summary: Horizontal offset (px) of the saved custom island position

key.name: pin-offset-y
key.summary: Vertical offset (px) of the saved custom island position

key.name: eq-style
key.summary: Shape of the music visualizer

key.name: accent-color
key.summary: Visualizer color (#rrggbb)

key.name: show-volume
key.summary: Show volume and brightness changes (replaces GNOME pop-up)

key.name: show-battery
key.summary: Show charger plugged/unplugged

key.name: show-recording
key.summary: Show screen recording timer

key.name: show-bluetooth
key.summary: Show Bluetooth devices connecting

key.name: show-progress
key.summary: Show download and file copy progress
